page.layout: One column of text. Running head at top left, page number at top right, with a subhead "Aliud Exemplum." beneath it. Several arithmetic displays set within the text. Signature at foot. No margin notes.

page.notes: The "Aliud Exemplum." line is italic beneath the running head; it is given as a level 2 heading. The asterisks in "7* 4 5* 4" are small printed marks, possibly bracket or multiplication signs; the bracket to the right of the first display is not transcribed.
